body.p: Use Explain commit with AI to generate a summary of all changes made in a commit, for example when the existing commit message does not provide enough detail or you want a rapid overview of what changed.
To generate a summary of a commit with AI, go to Git History. Right-click a commit to open the context menu and choose Explain Commit with AI.
The AI Positron view opens and explains the commits.

fig.title: Explain Commit with AI on Git History

body.p: You can customize how commit explanations are generated in the Git Client AI preferences. For example, you can add project-specific instructions and save them in an project file so the same guidance is shared across a team.
